test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence indirect speech.

"It's a bright day today," said mother.

options.text: Mother said that it was a bright day that day.
Mother said that it is a bright day that day.
Mother said that it was a bright day today.
Mother said that it would be a bright day that day.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Mother said that it was a bright day that day.**'
